description: Create a page in the company brain. Call get_wiki_tree first: most material belongs on a page that already exists, and a brain with one page per source is a filing cabinet, not a brain. Links in the body are verified against the workspace before the page is written — a link that resolves to nothing rejects the whole call, naming the target. Give the page an icon: the tree and the sidebar draw one glyph per row, so a brain where every page looks alike can only be read by reading every label.

body.description: Markdown, and the reason the page exists — a page with a title and nothing under it is refused. Follow the templates in get_wiki_schema, and skip a section rather than filling it with nothing.

emoji.description: One emoji, the page's icon in the tree and the sidebar. Choose for what the page is about.

folder_path.description: Path of an existing folder, as shown by get_wiki_tree (e.g. 'Product/Design'). Omit to place this at the wiki root — which is the right default: open a folder only once a subject carries several pages.

title.description: The page's title, which is also its name in the tree.

workspace_slug.description: The workspace slug, from any Monnet URL (e.g. 'monnet-team-410b'). Call list_workspaces if you do not have it.

name: create_wiki_page
